# tools: support asdf

Adopt [asdf](https://asdf-vm.com), the plugin-based version manager for language runtimes (Node, Python, Ruby, Go, …), instead of one Homebrew-installed version of each. **Motivation:** "sometimes it's more useful than docker" — per-project runtime versions without containers; the [Hexlet guide](https://guides.hexlet.io/ru/version-managers/) on version managers is the background reading.
